name: Orochimaru [New Year]
balanceNote: All attack damage uses buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. All area attacks hit all enemies. The explicitly stated 10% max-HP True damage follow-up remains a separate HP effect. Manda and Eight Headed Serpent are original skill actors, not independent summoned combat units. Damage coefficients, 60% Mystery evasion, 40% Repulse and 20% additional Critical Rate are local values where the reference gives no number. Both Mystery forms use cooldown 2 as requested. Base Speed 180; level growth remains.

mystery.name: Summoning Jutsu - Manda
mystery.description: Causes unavoidable damage and Laceration to all ninjas in the opponent's lineup, causes Interruption to the selected unit. After this skill is executed, Orochimaru's Mystery changes to Reincarnation - Eight Headed Serpent Jutsu. If this skill defeats a unit, additionally executes Additional Skill: Eight Headed Serpent Jutsu. Cooldown 2; Battlefield Cooldown 0; Chakra Cost 20.

standard.name: Sword of Kusanagi - Striking Shadow Snakes
standard.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, a chance of causing Repulse. This skill is unavoidable, has additional Critical Rate increase and isn't subjected to the opponent's defensive skills. If the attacked unit is suffering from Laceration, additionally causes True damage based on 10% of that unit's max HP and after executed, Orochimaru suffers from Level 2 - Blindness until the end of the round.

standard2.name: Sword of Kusanagi - Striking Shadow Snakes
standard2.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, a chance of causing Repulse. This skill is unavoidable, has additional Critical Rate increase and isn't subjected to the opponent's defensive skills. If the attacked unit is suffering from Laceration, additionally causes True damage based on 10% of that unit's max HP and after executed, Orochimaru suffers from Level 2 - Blindness until the end of the round.

standard3.name: Sword of Kusanagi - Striking Shadow Snakes
standard3.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, a chance of causing Repulse. This skill is unavoidable, has additional Critical Rate increase and isn't subjected to the opponent's defensive skills. If the attacked unit is suffering from Laceration, additionally causes True damage based on 10% of that unit's max HP and after executed, Orochimaru suffers from Level 2 - Blindness until the end of the round.

chase.name: Wind Style - Great Breakthrough
chase.description: Chases and Attacks a Low Floated unit, causes Repulse, then causes damage to all units in the opponent's lineup. After every time this skill is executed, it receives one extra Chase condition in the following order: High Float, Knockdown, Repulse. If this skill has 4 Chase conditions, it becomes unavoidable and additionally dispels Perseverance of all units hit.

seal.name: Sealing Jutsu - Five Elements Seal
seal.description: At the end of the round, causes unavoidable damage, guaranteed Level 2 - Acupuncture and Five Elements Seal to a random opponent unit. After this skill is executed, reduces Orochimaru's Mystery Cooldown by 1 and your lineup's Mystery Chakra Cost by 20 (stackable up to 2 times) until the end of the next round.

additionalSeal.name: Sealing Jutsu - Five Elements Seal
additionalSeal.description: At the end of the round, causes unavoidable damage, guaranteed Level 2 - Acupuncture and Five Elements Seal to a random opponent unit. After this skill is executed, reduces Orochimaru's Mystery Cooldown by 1 and your lineup's Mystery Chakra Cost by 20 (stackable up to 2 times) until the end of the next round.

serpent.name: Reincarnation - Eight Headed Serpent Jutsu
serpent.description: Causes unavoidable damage to all units in the opponent's field. This skill causes 30% more damage to units having Immunity or Super Armor (these 2 effects can stack together). After this skill is executed, Orochimaru's Mystery changes to Summoning Jutsu - Manda and he enters Explosive Mode until the end of the round. Explosive Mode: immune to Death and recovers 4% max HP whenever attacked until round end. Cooldown 2; Battlefield Cooldown 0; Chakra Cost 40.

additionalSerpent.name: Eight Headed Serpent Jutsu
additionalSerpent.description: Additional Skill: deals unavoidable Physical ATK damage to all enemies. Deals 30% extra damage against Immunity and 30% extra against Super Armor; both bonuses stack. Enters Explosive Mode until round end: cannot die and recovers 4% max HP whenever attacked.

evade.name: Earth Substitution Jutsu
evade.description: Orochimaru has high chances to evade Mystery skills and whenever he evades an attack, scales his Critical Rate by 8% (can be triggered 5 times per round) and he recovers 15% HP.

revive.name: New Year - Immortal Spirit
revive.description: If defeated, revives 2 rounds later with 50% max HP. A complete lineup defeat ends the battle; no-revival effects remain effective.

chases.name: Wind Style - Great Breakthrough
chases.description: Chases and Attacks a Low Floated unit, causes Repulse, then causes damage to all units in the opponent's lineup. After every time this skill is executed, it receives one extra Chase condition in the following order: High Float, Knockdown, Repulse. If this skill has 4 Chase conditions, it becomes unavoidable and additionally dispels Perseverance of all units hit.

passives.name: New Year - Immortal Spirit
passives.description: Orochimaru is immune to Debuffs and has Earth Substitution Jutsu. When Orochimaru executes a Trigger skill, scales his Physical ATK by 15% and when he suffers Trigger damage, executes Additional Skill: Five Elements Seal, can be triggered 5 times each round and is still active even when Orochimaru is controlled. When he is defeated, revives 2 rounds later with 50% HP.

passives.name: Earth Substitution Jutsu
passives.description: Orochimaru has high chances to evade Mystery skills and whenever he evades an attack, scales his Critical Rate by 8% (can be triggered 5 times per round) and he recovers 15% HP.

passives.name: New Year - Serpent Recovery
passives.description: Whenever Orochimaru receives any damage from an opponent, he has a 50% chance to recover HP equal to 105% of the actual damage received, capped at max HP. Can rescue a fatal hit; does not trigger on self HP costs or zero damage. Healing restrictions still apply.

passives.name: Five Elements Seal / Laceration
passives.description: Laceration: Level 2 Debuff; healing received is reduced by 50% until the end of the next round. Five Elements Seal: Level 2 Debuff; cannot recover Chakra and Physical ATK is suppressed to 70% of base Physical ATK for 1 round. Each Trigger executed by a sealed ninja reduces all allies' Physical DEF and Resistance by 20%, up to 3 stacks, until round end. Level 2 Acupuncture blocks Mystery for 1 round. Level 2 Blindness prevents Standard Attacks until round end.

passives.name: New Year - Serpent Rebirth
passives.description: At the end of rounds 2, 4, 6 and every 2 rounds thereafter, while Orochimaru is alive, revives one random defeated allied ninja with 100% max HP. Cannot select himself, auxiliary summons or units forbidden to revive. No eligible ally means no revival that round. A complete lineup defeat still ends the battle.
